context.focus: Select a short, memorable, search-aware customer name while preserving the stable product id.
forbidden_scope: deleting or replacing prior architecture artifacts
design work before workflow contracts pass
invented market demand, search volume, customers, reviews, rankings, backlinks, citations, or performance
mass-generated public pages or keyword permutations

definition_of_done: At least three unique candidates include rationale, risks, and comparative scores.
At least two rejected alternatives include concrete reasons.
At least two source URLs or dated exact-name/category search notes are retained.
The selected name is one to three words and avoids generic utility labels.
The evidence states that legal, trademark, domain, company-name, and app-store clearance remain required before public launch.

After the owned section passes, append or update agent_evidence for product_naming_research_agent with status done, at least one scoped check in checks_passed, and an empty checks_failed list. Unfinished downstream stages are dependencies, not failures of this task.
